description: Declared before scoring: percentile rank within the 35-CMA population, 100 x (average rank - 1) / (n - 1); bounded 0-100, robust to extreme values without trimming, deterministic for ties, identical scale for every component
Score percentile at or above which a market is in the top quartile of its scenario
Score percentile below which a market is in the bottom quartile of its scenario
Pillar score at or above which a pillar leads a market's signal (classification)
Pillar score below which the other main pillar is weak (scale-led or momentum-led classification)
Minimum difference between scale and momentum pillar scores to call a position scale-driven or momentum-driven
Rank movement (about one quartile of 35 markets) treated as material across scenarios, normalizations or leave-one-indicator-out
Spearman correlation between score and log scale at or above which a scenario mostly restates market size
Share of score variance from one component at or above which that component dominates a scenario
|12-month mean net-formation rate| must exceed this multiple of its standard error (SD / sqrt(12)) for a clear momentum direction (heuristic; ignores autocorrelation)
Fixed random seed for the weight-perturbation analysis
Lower bound for each core pillar weight before renormalization
Upper bound for each core pillar weight before renormalization
